q: Budgeting is defined as a process of planning the activities of an organisation's ____ for a future period, usually the next year.
Which Chapter of the Stores Code deals with the procedure and preparation of the Stores Budget?
Besides planning for the future period, the Budget also enables ____ planning activities for the current year.
A Budget is expressed in quantitative terms, usually in ____ terms.
A Budget normally covers a specified period of time, usually ____.
The Stores Budget for the ensuing year and the Revised Estimates for the current year are prepared by the ____.
The Stores Budget prepared by the COS is duly vetted by the ____ before submission.
The Stores Budget and Revised Estimates are submitted to the Railway Board by ____ of each year.
Why have the Stores Budget submission dates been advanced?

options.A: Due to advancement of the General Budget

q: The Stores Budget is prepared in how many parts?
Which of the following are the two parts of the Stores Budget?

options.C: Fuel oil and general purpose stores

q: The Stores Budget covers stores for the consumption of ____ activities.
Guidelines for making the Budget Estimates, incorporating special features, are issued from time to time by the ____.
Budget Estimates are submitted along with Annexures A, B and C. Annexure A is the ____.

options.A: Analysis of balance of stores in stock
options.B: Statement showing Major Groups of Stores
options.C: Assets procured on account of acquisition, construction and replacement

q: Annexure B of the Stores Budget is the ____.

options.B: Statement showing Major Groups of Stores
options.C: Analysis of balance of Stores in Stock
options.D: Assets procured on account of acquisition, construction and replacement

q: Annexure C of the Stores Budget covers ____.

options.D: Assets procured on account of acquisition, construction and replacement

q: The analysis under Annexures A, B and C is made with the object of ensuring ____.
Under Annexure A, analysis is made on groups of stores such as ____.

options.B: Bridge Works, P. Way and Manufacturing stores

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the annexures submitted with the Stores Budget?

options.A: Annexure B - Analysis of balance of stores in stock
options.D: Annexure A - Major Groups of Stores

q: The Opening Balance for the ensuing period is an estimated figure which includes ____.

options.A: the total issues during the previous year
options.D: the estimated book value of the stores expected to be in stock at the end of the current year

q: Which of the following is a component of the Opening Balance of the Stores Budget?

options.A: Estimated net result of outstanding balances under stores suspense heads of Purchases (imported/indigenous) and sales
options.B: Total debits during the ensuing year

q: The third element of the Opening Balance is the amount expected to be outstanding in the ____ for the year being closed.

options.A: Actuals for last year, BG for current year, RE and BE
options.C: Only budget grant and budget estimates

q: Under Estimated Debits, stores for works are estimated based on the ____.

options.A: average of last three years' issues
options.B: divisional estimates of works proposed in the ensuing year

q: For Estimated Debits, stores for General Purpose are estimated as ____.

options.A: issues to revenue plus issues to capital
options.C: throw forward from previous year plus indents for the current year less estimated throw forward to the next year
options.D: total indents of the last three years divided by three

options.A: targeted outturn of components in the shops
options.D: sales trend of the previous year

options.A: stores purchased but not paid for
options.B: leftover and released materials from works

options.C: fabricated stores, based on the estimates

options.D: repairs and maintenance of operational work

options.A: average annual consumption (AAC) worked out for the last 3 years
options.B: total consumption of the previous year alone
options.C: indents certified during the current year
options.D: budget grant of the Railway Board

q: For 'Sales and transfers' under Estimated Credits, no accurate estimate can be made; the estimate is based on ____.

options.B: the trend of movement of stores and expected sales
options.C: the average of last five years' scrap prices

options.A: the total of debits during the year

options.B: opening balance and the closing balance

options.C: full explanations and the amount involved
